**Finding: Compliant** (preferred position) — no redline proposed.

- **No exclusivity binds us.** Searches across the document for "exclusive", "sole", "requirements", "procure", and competitor language surface only unrelated uses: warranty exclusivity (§ 5.2), *non*exclusive license grants (§§ 5.4, 12.1), tax-exclusive charges (§ 4.3), and "sole discretion" references.
- **Freedom expressly preserved.** § 14.16 (Freedom of Action): "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others." — this affirmatively confirms our ability to source comparable services elsewhere.
- **§ 14.11 (No Resale)** restricts reselling the Services, not our sourcing, so it is not an exclusivity/sole-supplier covenant and is not flagged under this rule.
